input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no exit/transition clause. Section 11.3 preserves Corio's right to serve then-existing Customers and Commerce One's ongoing support obligation (and Section 12 provides source-code escrow), but neither obliges Commerce One to provide transition assistance on wind-down, and the only data-related term lets each party "return or destroy" the other's Confidential Information at its own election, with no format, no 30-day return window and no deletion certification. That falls short of the fallback (90 days assistance plus data export within 30 days) and edges toward the walk-away case of no data return. Inserted new Section 11.4 at the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in machine-readable format, then certified deletion), expressly without limiting Corio's surviving rights under Section 11.3; a 90-day assistance period is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 11.4 requiring Commerce One to provide transition assistance and return Corio data on exit
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause requiring Commerce One, on request, to provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and to return our data and Confidential Information in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days before deleting and certifying deletion. Our playbook requires an orderly wind-down and data return on exit; we can live with a ninety (90) day assistance period if six months is an issue.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, and without limiting Corio's rights that survive under Section 11.3, Commerce One shall (i) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current standard rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of Corio's written request, return to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One's possession or control, together with Corio's Confidential Information, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.
